summary: FERC grants the Joint Movants' motion and holds the EL26-68 SPP show cause proceeding in abeyance for 95 days, to November 20, 2026, with answers due December 21, 2026. SPP plans a section 205 filing after its November 17 Board vote.

points.point: FERC grants the August 3 motion of SPP and a group of transmission owners for 95 days.
points.quote: we grant the Abeyance Motion filed by Joint Movants and hold this proceeding in abeyance for 95 days, until November 20, 2026.

points.point: Joint Movants describe SPP's planned work on alternative technologies, cost shifting protections, co-location and flexible-load services.
points.quote: SPP anticipates developing revisions to its High Impact Large Load (HILL) process that will incorporate the evaluation of alternative transmission technologies into the study process.

points.point: SPP expects stakeholder approval of its Price Adaptive Load proposal for non-firm service on November 17, 2026.
points.quote: SPP anticipates final stakeholder approval of the proposal on November 17, 2026.

points.point: The five days beyond the usual 90 reflect a Board meeting moved from November 3 to November 17.
points.quote: the date of the SPP Board meeting was originally scheduled on November 3, 2026 but was changed to accommodate upcoming elections

points.point: The Regional State Committee, Missouri Commission and CEBA filed answers supporting the motion.
points.quote: The RSC, Public Service Commission of the State of Missouri, and Corporate Energy Buyers Association filed timely answers in support of Joint Movants' Abeyance Motion.

points.point: Responses are due November 20 and answers December 21, 2026; a timely section 205 filing suspends the response duty.
points.quote: responses to the Show Cause Order will be due on November 20, 2026, and answers to responses will be due on December 21, 2026.

throughLine.text: Moves the E-9 SPP 60-day show cause response from August 17 to November 20, 2026, accepting SPP's stakeholder schedule for a section 205 filing.

figures.label: Abeyance granted for SPP show cause proceeding
figures.quote: hold this proceeding in abeyance for 95 days, until November 20, 2026.
